ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Figure 13 is a schematic diagram of energy allocation in southern China and surrounding areas, and the figure marks routes such as “Second West-to-East Gas Pipeline” and “West-to-East Electricity Transmission Southern Route”; among them, the “West-to-East Electricity Transmission Southern Route” transmits from the southwest direction of China eastward, with the endpoint pointing toward Hong Kong and the Pearl River Delta area. Then reason: The southwestern region where the southern route starts is rich in hydropower resources, which is the main source of electricity for the southern route; at the same time, this region also has some coal power and thermal power participating as supplements. Therefore, the power composition of the southern route project should be summarized as mainly hydropower, with thermal power as supplementary.
